core_obligations: Parts (1) and (3) (proof lines 13787-13794): the exactness of F |-> F(U) is part of the definition of weak contractibility, and for a G-torsor F the map F -> * is surjective on the site, so by the definition of weak contractibility F has a section over U.
Part (2) (proof lines 13789-13791): since the sections functor is exact, its higher right derived functors vanish, which is exactly the vanishing of H^p(U, F) for p >= 1.
proof_roadmap: Read exactness and the torsor statement off the definition of weak contractibility.
Use the vanishing of the right derived functors of an exact functor for the cohomology statement.
difficulty_reason: The lemma records the three defining consequences of weak contractibility for an object U: exactness of sections, vanishing of the higher cohomology and the existence of sections of torsors (statement lines 13772-13784). The proof (proof lines 13786-13794) reads the first and third off the definition and obtains the vanishing from the right-derived-functor lemma applied to the exact sections functor. H2: three short readings, written out.
